parole.significato: Franconian (person from the German region of Franconia (Franken), northern Bavaria)
parole.testo: From Middle High German Franke, from Old High German Franko, from Frankish *Franko, from Proto-Germanic *frankô.

From Middle High German trotten (late 14th c.), from Old French trotter, troter (“to trot”). The French verb is possibly from Old High German trotōn (“to press wine”) or from a hypothetical Frankish *trottōn (“to tread”), both related with German treten.
